```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=6, dpi=150)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(readxl)
  library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(plotly)
  library(leaflet); library(DT); library(networkD3)
  library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
  library(tidyr); library(stringdist); library(stringr)
})

DROPBOX <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Dropbox (Personal)",
                     "mystery_shopper", "Corbi study", "ENT", "Data")
BOARD_CSV <- here::here("data", "ent", "board_results_abohns_verification_results.csv")

source_matches_board <- function(candidate, match_set) {
  mapply(
    function(cand, accepted) {
      if (is.na(cand) || is.na(accepted) || accepted == "") return(NA)
      cand %in% strsplit(accepted, " \\+ ")[[1]]
    },
    candidate,
    match_set,
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
}

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
comp <- read_xlsx(file.path(DROPBOX, "enthealth_nppes_comparison.xlsx"),
                  sheet = "Comparison")

geo  <- read_csv(file.path(DROPBOX, "results_geocoded.csv"),
                 na=c("","NA"), show_col_types=FALSE)

board_raw <- read_csv(BOARD_CSV, show_col_types=FALSE)

# Harmonise column types
comp <- comp |>
  mutate(
    phone_enthealth = as.character(phone_enthealth),
    phone_nppes     = as.character(phone_nppes),
    across(where(is.logical), as.character)
  )

# Bring in training/cert columns from geocoded file
extra_cols <- geo |>
  select(url, fellowship_name, board_names,
         any_of(c("is_board_certified","career_stage","has_fellowship")))
comp <- left_join(comp, extra_cols, by="url")

board_truth <- board_raw |>
  mutate(
    first_key = toupper(trimws(query_first_name)),
    last_key  = toupper(trimws(query_last_name)),
    state_key = toupper(trimws(query_state)),
    board_label = case_when(
      certification == "Otolaryngology - Head & Neck Surgery" ~ "Head and Neck Surgery",
      certification == "Complex Pediatric Otolaryngology"     ~ "Pediatric Otolaryngology",
      certification == "Neurotology"                          ~ "Neurotology",
      certification == "Sleep Medicine"                       ~ "Sleep Medicine",
      TRUE                                                    ~ certification
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    board_labels = paste(sort(unique(board_label)), collapse = " + "),
    board_specific_labels = paste(
      sort(unique(board_label[board_label != "General Otolaryngology"])),
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    board_match_set = {
      specs <- sort(unique(board_label[board_label != "General Otolaryngology"]))
      if (length(specs) == 0) "General Otolaryngology" else paste(specs, collapse = " + ")
    },
    board_primary_truth = {
      specs <- sort(unique(board_label[board_label != "General Otolaryngology"]))
      if (length(specs) == 0) {
        "General Otolaryngology"
      } else if (length(specs) == 1) {
        specs
      } else {
        "Multiple Board Certifications"
      }
    },
    board_n_certifications = n_distinct(board_label),
    board_meeting_cc_reqs = paste(sort(unique(meeting_cc_reqs)), collapse = " + "),
    board_source_url = dplyr::first(na.omit(source_url)),
    .by = c(first_key, last_key, state_key)
  )

comp <- comp |>
  mutate(
    first_key = toupper(trimws(first_name)),
    last_key  = toupper(trimws(last_name)),
    state_key = toupper(trimws(state_code))
  ) |>
  left_join(board_truth, by = c("first_key", "last_key", "state_key")) |>
  mutate(
    board_available = !is.na(board_primary_truth),
    enthealth_matches_board = source_matches_board(specialty_primary, board_match_set),
    nppes_matches_board     = source_matches_board(nppes_specialty, board_match_set),
    board_agreement_bucket = case_when(
      !board_available ~ NA_character_,
      isTRUE(enthealth_matches_board) & isTRUE(nppes_matches_board) ~ "Both match board",
      isTRUE(enthealth_matches_board) & !isTRUE(nppes_matches_board) ~ "enthealth only matches board",
      !isTRUE(enthealth_matches_board) & isTRUE(nppes_matches_board) ~ "NPPES only matches board",
      TRUE ~ "Neither matches board"
    )
  )

matched   <- comp |> filter(!is.na(npi_matched))
spec_both <- matched |> filter(!is.na(specialty_primary), !is.na(nppes_specialty))
phone_both <- matched |> filter(!is.na(phone_enthealth), phone_enthealth != "NA",
                                 !is.na(phone_nppes),     phone_nppes     != "NA")
board_both <- comp |>
  filter(board_available, !is.na(specialty_primary), !is.na(nppes_specialty))

# Taxonomy → readable label
TAX_LABEL <- c(
  "207Y00000X" = "General Otolaryngology",
  "207YX0007X" = "Head and Neck Surgery",
  "207YX0905X" = "Otology / Neurotology",
  "207YP0228X" = "Pediatric Otolaryngology",
  "207YX0901X" = "Otolaryngic Allergy",
  "207YX0602X" = "Facial Plastic Surgery",
  "207YS0012X" = "Sleep Medicine",
  "207YS0123X" = "Sleep Medicine (alt code)",
  "207YX0400X" = "Rhinology"
)
```

# Overview {.tabset}

This appendix validates the subspecialty classification used to assign mystery-caller scripts.
Physicians were sampled from **enthealth.org** (the American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery's
public "Find an ENT" directory), where ENTs self-report their subspecialty.
We cross-referenced every physician against the **NPPES February 2026** national registry,
which records up to five NUCC taxonomy codes per provider, and the **ABOHNS board verification**
results in [data/ent/board_results_abohns_verification_results.csv](/Users/tylermuffly/isochrones/data/ent/board_results_abohns_verification_results.csv),
which we treat as the source of truth when board data are available.

<div class="highlight-box">
**Bottom line:** ABOHNS board verification is the primary truth set for subspecialty classification.
When board data are unavailable, enthealth.org remains a substantially better proxy than NPPES.
NPPES taxonomy codes are assigned at initial NPI enumeration and rarely updated thereafter —
many physicians whom enthealth or ABOHNS identify as subspecialists are still coded as generic
**General Otolaryngology (207Y00000X)** in NPPES.
</div>

```{r summary-cards}
n_total    <- nrow(comp)
n_matched  <- nrow(matched)
n_spec_both <- nrow(spec_both)
n_agree    <- sum(spec_both$specialty_agreement %in% c("exact_match","matched_secondary_taxonomy"))
n_disagree <- sum(spec_both$specialty_agreement == "disagree")
pct_agree  <- round(100 * n_agree / n_spec_both)
n_board    <- sum(comp$board_available, na.rm = TRUE)
n_board_both <- nrow(board_both)
```

**At a glance:**
`r format(n_total, big.mark=",")` enthealth physicians ·
`r format(n_matched, big.mark=",")` matched to NPPES (80.8%) ·
`r format(n_spec_both, big.mark=",")` with specialty in both sources ·
`r format(n_board, big.mark=",")` matched to ABOHNS board results ·
`r pct_agree`% enthealth vs NPPES agreement

<div class="highlight-box">
**Pass 1 (exact)** captures **78.4%** of all physicians in a single step.
The 19.2% who remain unmatched include physicians who changed states, retired between
enthealth scrape and NPPES snapshot, or whose names differ substantially between the two systems
(hyphenated names, accent marks, transliterations).
</div>

## Match Quality by Pass

```{r match-pass-table}
pass_tbl <- comp |>
  count(match_pass) |>
  mutate(
    Pass = case_when(
      is.na(match_pass) ~ "No match",
      match_pass == 1   ~ "Pass 1 — exact last + state + first initial",
      match_pass == 2   ~ "Pass 2 — exact last + state (relax initial)",
      match_pass == 3   ~ "Pass 3 — strip hyphens/apostrophes",
      match_pass == 4   ~ "Pass 4 — Levenshtein ≤ 1 on last name",
      TRUE              ~ paste("Pass", match_pass)
    ),
    `N` = format(n, big.mark=","),
    `%` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100*n/nrow(comp))
  ) |>
  select(Pass, N, `%`)

kable(pass_tbl, align=c("l","r","r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE) |>
  row_spec(nrow(pass_tbl), bold=TRUE, color="white", background="#C0392B")
```

# Specialty Agreement {.tabset}

## Overall Agreement

```{r agree-table}
agree_tbl <- spec_both |>
  mutate(agreement_label = case_when(
    specialty_agreement == "exact_match"               ~ "Exact match",
    specialty_agreement == "matched_secondary_taxonomy" ~ "Match in secondary NPPES taxonomy",
    specialty_agreement == "disagree"                  ~ "Disagree",
    TRUE                                               ~ specialty_agreement
  )) |>
  count(agreement_label) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(
    `%` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100*n/sum(n)),
    N   = format(n, big.mark=",")
  ) |>
  select(`Agreement` = agreement_label, N, `%`)

kable(agree_tbl, align=c("l","r","r"),
      caption=paste0("Specialty agreement among ", format(n_spec_both, big.mark=","),
                     " physicians with specialty in both sources")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover"), full_width=FALSE) |>
  row_spec(1, background="#EAFAF1") |>
  row_spec(3, background="#FDEDEC")
```


## Specialty Heatmap Crosstab

```{r heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
cross <- spec_both |>
  count(specialty_primary, nppes_specialty) |>
  group_by(specialty_primary) |>
  mutate(pct_row = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

row_order <- cross |> group_by(specialty_primary) |>
  summarise(tot = sum(n)) |> arrange(desc(tot)) |> pull(specialty_primary)
col_order <- cross |> group_by(nppes_specialty) |>
  summarise(tot = sum(n)) |> arrange(desc(tot)) |> pull(nppes_specialty)

cross$specialty_primary <- factor(cross$specialty_primary, levels=rev(row_order))
cross$nppes_specialty   <- factor(cross$nppes_specialty,   levels=col_order)

ggplot(cross, aes(x=nppes_specialty, y=specialty_primary, fill=pct_row)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(n>=5, paste0(n,"\n(",scales::percent(pct_row,accuracy=1),")"), "")),
            size=3, color="white", fontface="bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#EBF5FB", mid="#2980B9", high="#1F4E79",
                       midpoint=0.5, labels=scales::percent_format(),
                       name="Row %") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width=14)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Specialty Classification: enthealth.org (rows) vs. NPPES Primary Taxonomy (columns)",
    subtitle = "Cell values = N physicians and row percentage. Dark = high row concentration.",
    x        = "NPPES Primary Taxonomy",
    y        = "enthealth Specialty",
    caption  = paste0("n = ", format(n_spec_both, big.mark=","),
                      " physicians matched in both sources")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1, size=9),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size=10),
    plot.title    = element_text(face="bold", color="#1F4E79", size=14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color="#555", size=11),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin   = margin(5, 10, 5, 10)
  )
```

<div class="highlight-box">
**Reading the heatmap:** Diagonal cells (same label in both sources) represent agreement.
Off-diagonal dark cells reveal where enthealth and NPPES systematically disagree.
The **"General Otolaryngology" NPPES column** is consistently dark across every enthealth
subspecialty row — the NPPES default absorbs physicians from all ENT sub-fields.
</div>

## Sankey: How Specialties Flow

```{r sankey}
# Build nodes and links for sankey
sankey_df <- spec_both |>
  count(from = specialty_primary, to = nppes_specialty) |>
  filter(n >= 10)

nodes_from <- data.frame(name = unique(sankey_df$from))
nodes_to   <- data.frame(name = paste0(unique(sankey_df$to), " (NPPES)"))
nodes      <- rbind(nodes_from, data.frame(name=setdiff(nodes_to$name, nodes_from$name)))

sankey_df$source <- match(sankey_df$from, nodes$name) - 1
sankey_df$target <- match(paste0(sankey_df$to, " (NPPES)"), nodes$name) - 1
# Add any NPPES nodes not yet in node list
missing_nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(paste0(sankey_df$to, " (NPPES)"))[
  !unique(paste0(sankey_df$to, " (NPPES)")) %in% nodes$name])
nodes <- rbind(nodes, missing_nodes)
sankey_df$source <- match(sankey_df$from, nodes$name) - 1
sankey_df$target <- match(paste0(sankey_df$to, " (NPPES)"), nodes$name) - 1

networkD3::sankeyNetwork(
  Links   = as.data.frame(sankey_df),
  Nodes   = as.data.frame(nodes),
  Source  = "source",
  Target  = "target",
  Value   = "n",
  NodeID  = "name",
  fontSize= 12,
  nodeWidth = 25,
  sinksRight = FALSE
)
```

# Board Truth {.tabset}

## Agreement Against ABOHNS

```{r board-agreement-table}
board_compare_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Source, ~Matches, ~Total,
  "enthealth vs board", sum(board_both$enthealth_matches_board, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(board_both),
  "NPPES vs board",     sum(board_both$nppes_matches_board,     na.rm = TRUE), nrow(board_both)
) |>
  mutate(
    `% match` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * Matches / Total),
    Matches = format(Matches, big.mark = ","),
    Total   = format(Total, big.mark = ",")
  )

kable(board_compare_tbl, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
      caption = paste0("Agreement with ABOHNS board truth among ",
                       format(nrow(board_both), big.mark = ","),
                       " physicians with all three sources")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Board Crosswalk

```{r board-crosswalk}
board_cross <- board_both |>
  count(board_primary_truth, specialty_primary, nppes_specialty, sort = TRUE) |>
  group_by(board_primary_truth) |>
  summarise(
    enthealth_top = paste0(first(specialty_primary), " (", first(n), ")"),
    nppes_top     = paste0(first(nppes_specialty), " (", first(n), ")"),
    total         = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(total = format(total, big.mark = ","))

kable(board_cross,
      col.names = c("ABOHNS Board Truth", "Most Common enthealth Label",
                    "Most Common NPPES Label", "N"),
      align = c("l", "l", "l", "r"),
      caption = "Most common enthealth and NPPES labels within each board-certified category") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r board-truth-map}
      "<b>NPPES:</b> ", nppes_specialty, "<br>",
      "<b>Agreement:</b> ", board_agreement_bucket, "<br><br>",
      "<a href='", url, "' target='_blank'>&#128279; enthealth profile</a>",
      " &nbsp;|&nbsp; ",
      "<a href='", nppes_url, "' target='_blank'>&#128279; NPPES record</a>",
      board_link
    )
  )

leaflet(board_map_df) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~board_color,

    opacity = 0.9,
    radius = 4,
    stroke = FALSE,
    popup = ~popup_text,
    label = ~paste(full_name, "-", board_agreement_bucket)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#27AE60", "#1F4E79", "#F39C12", "#C0392B"),
    labels = c("Both match board", "enthealth only matches board",
               "NPPES only matches board", "Neither matches board"),
    title = "Agreement vs ABOHNS"
  )
```

<div class="highlight-box">
This map uses **ABOHNS board verification as the reference standard**.
Blue points are the pattern of greatest practical interest: enthealth agrees with board truth,

# Anomalies and Tricky Cases {.tabset}

## Anomaly 1 — Facial Plastic → Sleep Medicine

<div class="anomaly-box">
**118 physicians** self-identify as **Facial Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery** on enthealth
but are coded as **Sleep Medicine (207YS0123X)** in NPPES. This is almost certainly a
data-entry error at NPI enrollment — the taxonomy codes are adjacent in some registry
dropdown lists. These physicians are correctly classified by enthealth.
</div>

```{r anomaly1}
anom1 <- comp |>
  filter(!is.na(npi_matched),
         specialty_primary == "Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery",
         nppes_specialty == "Sleep Medicine") |>
  select(`Name` = full_name, `State` = state_code, `City` = city,
         `enthealth Specialty` = specialty_primary,
         `NPPES Primary Taxonomy` = nppes_taxonomy_1,
         `NPPES Tax 2` = nppes_taxonomy_2,
         `NPPES Tax 3` = nppes_taxonomy_3,
         `NPPES Org` = nppes_org) |>
  head(25)

datatable(anom1, caption="Facial Plastic specialists coded as Sleep Medicine in NPPES (first 25 shown)",
          rownames=FALSE, options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE),
          class="compact stripe hover")
```

**Why this happens:** The NUCC code for Facial Plastic Surgery within Otolaryngology is `207YX0602X`.
The code for Sleep Medicine is `207YS0123X`. In some EHR and credentialing systems, these appear
near each other in an alphabetical dropdown under "Otolaryngology" sub-specialties,
and physicians selecting their taxonomy at NPI enrollment may pick the wrong adjacent entry.
Since NPPES records are rarely audited or corrected, the error persists indefinitely.

## Anomaly 2 — Neurotology → Allergy

<div class="anomaly-box">
**101 physicians** self-identify as **Neurotology** on enthealth but carry
**Otolaryngic Allergy (207YX0901X)** as their NPPES primary taxonomy.
Again this is a dropdown proximity error: 207YX0905X (Otology/Neurotology) and
207YX0901X (Allergy) differ by only one digit in a field where providers self-select at enrollment.
</div>

```{r anomaly2}
anom2 <- comp |>
  filter(!is.na(npi_matched),
         specialty_primary == "Neurotology",
         nppes_specialty == "Allergy") |>
  select(`Name` = full_name, `State` = state_code, `City` = city,
         `enthealth Specialty` = specialty_primary,
         `NPPES Tax 1` = nppes_taxonomy_1,
         `NPPES Tax 2` = nppes_taxonomy_2,
         `Fellowship` = fellowship_name,
         `Board Cert` = board_names) |>
  head(25)

datatable(anom2, caption="Neurotologists coded as Otolaryngic Allergy in NPPES (first 25 shown)",
          rownames=FALSE, options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE),
          class="compact stripe hover")
```

**Ground-truth check:** For the 101 physicians in this bucket, we can cross-reference
their enthealth fellowship training. Fellowship programs in Neurotology confirm the
enthealth label is correct; none of these physicians report allergy fellowships.

## Anomaly 3 — General in NPPES, Subspecialist on enthealth

<div class="warning-box">
This is the largest anomaly: **1,773 physicians** (64% of all enthealth subspecialists
with an NPPES match) are coded as generic **General Otolaryngology** in NPPES despite
listing a subspecialty on enthealth. This is NOT a coding error — it reflects how NPPES
taxonomy codes work. Physicians register their NPI once (often during residency or
early practice) and never update the taxonomy field.
</div>

```{r anomaly3}
anom3 <- comp |>
  filter(!is.na(npi_matched),
         !is.na(specialty_primary),
         specialty_primary != "General Otolaryngology",
         nppes_taxonomy_1 == "207Y00000X",
         is.na(nppes_taxonomy_2) | nppes_taxonomy_2 == "") |>
  mutate(
    fellowship_flag = ifelse(!is.na(fellowship_name), "Fellowship trained", "No fellowship listed")
  ) |>
  select(`Name` = full_name, `State` = state_code,
         `enthealth Specialty` = specialty_primary,
         `NPPES Tax 1` = nppes_taxonomy_1,
         `Fellowship` = fellowship_name,
         `Board Certs` = board_names,
         `Fellowship Status` = fellowship_flag) |>
  head(30)

datatable(anom3, caption="Subspecialists on enthealth coded as generic General ENT in NPPES (first 30 shown)",
          rownames=FALSE, options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE),
          class="compact stripe hover")
```

```{r anomaly3-breakdown}
anom3_sum <- comp |>
  filter(!is.na(npi_matched),
         !is.na(specialty_primary),
         specialty_primary != "General Otolaryngology",
         nppes_taxonomy_1 == "207Y00000X") |>
  count(specialty_primary, sort=TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    `%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100*n/sum(n)),
    N   = format(n, big.mark=",")
  ) |>
  select(`enthealth Subspecialty` = specialty_primary, N, `%`)

kable(anom3_sum, caption="Which subspecialties are most often coded General in NPPES?",
      align=c("l","r","r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover"), full_width=FALSE)
```

## Anomaly 4 — Vanity & Garbled Phone Numbers

<div class="highlight-box">
**Phone resolution highlights three tricky cases where standard digit-extraction fails:**
</div>

```{r anomaly4}
vanity_tbl <- data.frame(
  `Physician` = c("Gady Har-El MD FACS", "Minka L. Schofield MD",
                  "Nandini Govil MD MPH", "Barry L. Wenig MD MPH",
                  "Dennis J. Kitsko MD", "Donald L. Bomer MD"),
  `State` = c("NY","OH","GA","IL","PA","TX"),
  `Raw enthealth value` = c("(212) 744-4ENT", "(614) 366-ENTS",
                             "(412) 785-KIDS", "(312) 996-654",
                             "3705 5th Ave", "(###) ###-####"),
  `Issue` = c("Vanity: ENT=368", "Vanity: ENTS=3687",
               "Vanity: KIDS=5437 (pediatrics!)", "Truncated: last digit cut off",
               "Address in phone field", "Placeholder text"),
  `Resolution` = c("Decoded → (212) 744-4368", "Decoded → (614) 366-3687",
                   "Decoded → (412) 785-5437", "NPPES supplement → full number",
                   "NPPES supplement → correct phone", "NPPES supplement → correct phone"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

kable(vanity_tbl, caption="Tricky phone recovery cases") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover"), full_width=TRUE) |>
  column_spec(4, color="white",
              background=c("#C0392B","#C0392B","#E74C3C","#E74C3C","#C0392B","#C0392B")) |>

              background=c("#27AE60","#27AE60","#27AE60","#2980B9","#2980B9","#2980B9"))
```

**Pediatric vanity highlight:** `(412) 785-KIDS` is used by a *Pediatric Otolaryngologist* — the vanity number is itself diagnostic of subspecialty and confirms enthealth's classification.

# Geographic Patterns {.tabset}

## Map — Specialty Agreement by Location

```{r geo-map}
map_df <- comp |>
  filter(!is.na(npi_matched), !is.na(specialty_primary), !is.na(nppes_specialty)) |>
  left_join(geo |> select(url, latitude, longitude), by="url") |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
         latitude > 24, latitude < 50, longitude > -125, longitude < -66) |>
  mutate(
    agree_label = case_when(
      specialty_agreement == "exact_match"               ~ "Exact match",
      specialty_agreement == "matched_secondary_taxonomy" ~ "Secondary match",
      specialty_agreement == "disagree"                  ~ "Disagree"
    ),
    color = case_when(
      agree_label == "Exact match"      ~ "#27AE60",
      agree_label == "Secondary match"  ~ "#F39C12",
      agree_label == "Disagree"         ~ "#C0392B"
    ),
    nppes_url  = paste0("https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/provider-view/", npi_matched),
    board_text = dplyr::if_else(board_available, board_labels, "No board result linked"),
    board_link = dplyr::if_else(
      board_available & !is.na(board_source_url) & board_source_url != "",
      paste0(" &nbsp;|&nbsp; ",
             "<a href='", board_source_url, "' target='_blank'>&#128279; OTO board record</a>"),
      ""
    ),
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<b>", full_name, "</b><br>",
      city, ", ", state_code, "<br>",
      "<b>enthealth:</b> ", specialty_primary, "<br>",
      "<b>NPPES:</b> ", nppes_specialty, "<br>",
      "<b>OTO Board:</b> ", board_text, "<br><br>",
      "<a href='", url, "' target='_blank'>&#128279; enthealth profile</a>",
      " &nbsp;|&nbsp; ",
      "<a href='", nppes_url, "' target='_blank'>&#128279; NPPES record</a>",
      board_link
    )
  )

# Downsample for map performance while preserving disagree cases
set.seed(42)
map_sample <- bind_rows(
  map_df |> filter(agree_label == "Disagree"),
  map_df |> filter(agree_label != "Disagree") |> sample_frac(0.4)
)

leaflet(map_sample) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng      = ~longitude,
    lat      = ~latitude,
    color    = ~color,
    fillColor = ~color,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    opacity  = 0.9,
    radius   = 4,
    stroke   = FALSE,
    popup    = ~popup_text,
    label    = ~paste(full_name, "-", agree_label)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors   = c("#27AE60","#F39C12","#C0392B"),
    labels   = c("Exact match","Secondary taxonomy match","Disagree"),
    title    = "Specialty Agreement"
  )
```

*Click any dot for physician name, location, and specialty labels from both sources.*
Red dots (disagreements) are shown at full density; green/orange dots are a 40% random sample for clarity.

# Phone Number Validation {.tabset}

## Agreement Summary

```{r phone-agree-table}
phone_tbl <- phone_both |>
  mutate(match_label = case_when(
    phone_match == "exact_match"         ~ "Exact match (same 10 digits)",
    phone_match == "same_area_exchange"  ~ "Same area code + exchange (6 digits)",
    phone_match == "same_area_code"      ~ "Same area code only",
    phone_match == "different"           ~ "Completely different number",
    TRUE                                  ~ phone_match
  )) |>
  count(match_label) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(
    `%` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100*n/sum(n)),
    N   = format(n, big.mark=","),
    Interpretation = c(
      "Same direct-dial line in both sources",
      "Same practice, different extension or direct line",
      "Same geographic area, possibly different location or line",
      "Different practice location, personal cell, or answering service"
    )[match(match_label, c(
      "Exact match (same 10 digits)",
      "Same area code + exchange (6 digits)",
      "Same area code only",
      "Completely different number"
    ))]
  ) |>
  select(`Phone Agreement` = match_label, N, `%`, Interpretation)

kable(phone_tbl, caption=paste0("Phone number comparison: ",
      format(nrow(phone_both), big.mark=","), " physicians with both sources"),
      align=c("l","r","r","l")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover"), full_width=TRUE) |>
  row_spec(1, background="#EAFAF1") |>
  row_spec(4, background="#FDEDEC")
```

<div class="warning-box">
**Protocol change (effective this version):** Physicians with unknown specialty after
enthealth + NPPES cross-reference (n = **397**, 5.4%) are coded `specialty_primary = NA`.
Callers are NOT instructed to default to the General ENT script for these physicians.
Instead, callers conduct pre-call research (physician's practice website, ABOHNS verification)
to determine the appropriate script before dialing.
</div>

# Rural vs. Urban Practice Setting

Seven classification systems for characterizing ENT physician practice settings, ranging from
ZIP-code-level commuting patterns (RUCA) to county-level federal policy definitions (NCHS, RUCC).
Each map is independently colored; click any dot for physician details and registry links.

```{r rurality-setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyr); library(leaflet.extras) })

ISOCHRONES_DIR <- here::here()

# ── Helper: build physician base data ─────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_phone <- function(ph) {
  ph <- as.character(ph)
  ifelse(!is.na(ph) & nchar(ph) >= 10,
         paste0("(", substr(ph,1,3), ") ", substr(ph,4,6), "-", substr(ph,7,10)),
         NA_character_)
}

geo_conus <- geo |>
  mutate(zip5_key = sprintf("%05s", as.character(zip5))) |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
         is.finite(latitude), is.finite(longitude),
         latitude > 24, latitude < 50, longitude > -125, longitude < -66) |>
  left_join(comp |> select(url, npi_matched) |> distinct(url,.keep_all=TRUE), by="url") |>
  mutate(
    .phone_fmt    = fmt_phone(phone_digits),
    .spec         = coalesce(specialty_primary, "Unknown"),
    .enthealth_lk = paste0("<a href='",url,"' target='_blank'>&#128279; enthealth</a>"),
    .nppes_lk     = ifelse(!is.na(npi_matched),
                           paste0("<a href='https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/provider-view/",
                                  npi_matched,"' target='_blank'>&#128279; NPPES</a>"),
                           "")
  )

build_popup <- function(df, extra_line = "") {
  paste0(
    "<b>", df$full_name, "</b><br>",
    ifelse(!is.na(df$city) & !is.na(df$state_code),
           paste0(df$city, ", ", df$state_code, "<br>"), ""),
    "<b>Subspecialty:</b> ", df$.spec, "<br>",
    extra_line,
    ifelse(!is.na(df$.phone_fmt), paste0("<b>Phone:</b> ", df$.phone_fmt, "<br>"), ""),
    "<br>", df$.enthealth_lk,
    ifelse(nzchar(df$.nppes_lk), paste0(" &nbsp;|&nbsp; ", df$.nppes_lk), "")
  )
}

# ── Load crosswalks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# RUCA 2020 (ZIP-level)
ruca_zip <- read_csv(
  file.path(ISOCHRONES_DIR, "data/external/ruca_2020_zip.csv"),
  na=c("","NA"), show_col_types=FALSE,
  col_types=cols(ZIPCode=col_character())) |>
  mutate(zip5_key = sprintf("%05s", ZIPCode)) |>
  select(zip5_key, PrimaryRUCA) |>
  distinct(zip5_key, .keep_all=TRUE)

# FAR 2020 (ZIP-level) — all 4 levels loaded
# Levels are NESTED: FAR4 ⊆ FAR3 ⊆ FAR2 ⊆ FAR1
# FAR1 = ≥60 min from 50K+ city (broadest / least extreme)
# FAR4 = also ≥15 min from 5K–10K city (narrowest / most extreme frontier)
far_raw <- read_xlsx(
  file.path(ISOCHRONES_DIR, "data/external/far_2020_zip.xlsx"),
  sheet = "FAR2020 ZIP Code Data", skip = 1, col_names = TRUE,
  col_types = "text")
names(far_raw)[1:7] <- c("ZIPCode","State","POName","FAR1","FAR2","FAR3","FAR4")[1:7]
far_zip <- far_raw |>
  select(ZIPCode, FAR1, FAR2, FAR3, FAR4) |>
  mutate(
    zip5_key = sprintf("%05s", ZIPCode),
    across(FAR1:FAR4, as.integer),
    # Classify by the MOST EXTREME level that applies (FAR4 > FAR3 > FAR2 > FAR1)
    far_tier = case_when(
      FAR4 == 1 ~ "FAR 4 — Extreme Frontier",
      FAR3 == 1 ~ "FAR 3 — Deep Frontier",
      FAR2 == 1 ~ "FAR 2 — Remote",
      FAR1 == 1 ~ "FAR 1 — Remote (large cities only)",
      TRUE      ~ "Non-FAR"
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(zip5_key, .keep_all=TRUE)

# ZCTA → dominant county crosswalk
zcta_county <- read_csv(
  file.path(ISOCHRONES_DIR, "data/external/zcta_county_dominant_2020.csv"),
  col_types=cols(zip5=col_character(), county_fips=col_character()),
  show_col_types=FALSE) |>
  rename(zip5_key = zip5)

# NCHS Urban-Rural (county-level, 2013 & 2023)
nchs <- read_csv(
  file.path(ISOCHRONES_DIR, "data/external/nchs_urban_rural_codes.csv"),
  col_types=cols(STFIPS=col_character(), CTYFIPS=col_character()),
  show_col_types=FALSE) |>
  mutate(county_fips = paste0(sprintf("%02s", STFIPS), sprintf("%03s", CTYFIPS)))

# RUCC 2023 (county-level, Beale codes)
rucc_wide <- read_csv(
  file.path(ISOCHRONES_DIR, "data/external/rucc_2023.csv"),
  show_col_types=FALSE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from=Attribute, values_from=Value) |>
  mutate(county_fips = FIPS,
         RUCC_2023   = as.integer(RUCC_2023))

# Attach county_fips to physician base
geo_county <- geo_conus |>
  left_join(zcta_county, by="zip5_key")

# ── NCHS labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nchs_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Large Central Metro",
  "2" = "Large Fringe Metro",
  "3" = "Medium Metro",
  "4" = "Small Metro",
  "5" = "Micropolitan",
  "6" = "Noncore (Rural)"
)
nchs_colors <- c(
  "Large Central Metro" = "#08306B",
  "Large Fringe Metro"  = "#2171B5",
  "Medium Metro"        = "#6BAED6",
  "Small Metro"         = "#74C476",
  "Micropolitan"        = "#FD8D3C",
  "Noncore (Rural)"     = "#D7301F"
)

# ── RUCC labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rucc_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Metro ≥1 million",
  "2" = "Metro 250K–1M",
  "3" = "Metro <250K",
  "4" = "Nonmetro Urban ≥20K, adj",
  "5" = "Nonmetro Urban ≥20K, non-adj",
  "6" = "Nonmetro Urban 2.5K–20K, adj",
  "7" = "Nonmetro Urban 2.5K–20K, non-adj",
  "8" = "Rural, adj to metro",
  "9" = "Rural, non-adj to metro"
)
rucc_colors <- c(
  "Metro ≥1 million"                   = "#08306B",
  "Metro 250K–1M"                      = "#2171B5",
  "Metro <250K"                         = "#6BAED6",
  "Nonmetro Urban ≥20K, adj"           = "#41AB5D",
  "Nonmetro Urban ≥20K, non-adj"       = "#74C476",
  "Nonmetro Urban 2.5K–20K, adj"      = "#FED976",
  "Nonmetro Urban 2.5K–20K, non-adj" = "#FD8D3C",
  "Rural, adj to metro"                = "#E31A1C",
  "Rural, non-adj to metro"            = "#800026"
)
```

```{r rurality-schema-table}
schema_tbl <- data.frame(

    "Updated OMB 2023 delineations; replaces 2013 for current work",
```

## RUCA 2020 — Standard (4-Level)

*USDA zip-code commuting area codes 1–10 collapsed to Metropolitan / Micropolitan / Small Town / Rural.*

```{r ruca-4level}
df4 <- geo_conus |>
  left_join(ruca_zip, by="zip5_key") |>
  mutate(
    rurality = case_when(
      PrimaryRUCA %in% 1:3  ~ "Metropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA %in% 4:6  ~ "Micropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA %in% 7:9  ~ "Small Town",
      PrimaryRUCA == 10     ~ "Rural / Isolated",
      TRUE                  ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    .color = c(Metropolitan="#2C7BB6", Micropolitan="#74C476",
               `Small Town`="#FD8D3C", `Rural / Isolated`="#D7301F",
               Unknown="#BDBDBD")[rurality],
    .popup = build_popup(pick(everything()),
                         paste0("<b>Setting:</b> RUCA ", coalesce(as.character(PrimaryRUCA),"?"),
                                " — ", rurality, "<br>"))
  )

pal4 <- c(Metropolitan="#2C7BB6",Micropolitan="#74C476",`Small Town`="#FD8D3C",`Rural / Isolated`="#D7301F",Unknown="#BDBDBD")
lvls4 <- c("Metropolitan","Micropolitan","Small Town","Rural / Isolated","Unknown")
m4 <- leaflet(options=leafletOptions(preferCanvas=TRUE)) |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)
for (lv in lvls4) {
  sub <- df4[df4$rurality == lv, ]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  m4 <- m4 |> addCircleMarkers(data=sub, lng=~longitude, lat=~latitude,
    color=pal4[[lv]], fillColor=pal4[[lv]], fillOpacity=0.75, opacity=0.9,
    radius=4, stroke=FALSE, popup=~.popup,
    label=~paste(full_name, "—", rurality), group=lv)
}
m4 |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups=lvls4, options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=FALSE)) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", colors=unname(pal4[lvls4]), labels=lvls4,
            title="<b>RUCA 2020 — 4 Level</b>")
```

`r sprintf("Metro: %.0f%% · Micro: %.0f%% · Small Town: %.0f%% · Rural: %.0f%%",
   100*mean(df4$rurality=="Metropolitan"), 100*mean(df4$rurality=="Micropolitan"),
   100*mean(df4$rurality=="Small Town"),   100*mean(df4$rurality=="Rural / Isolated"))`

## RUCA 2020 — CMS 2-Level

*CMS uses RUCA 1–6 = Urban, RUCA 7–10 = Rural for Medicare rural payment add-ons and Critical Access Hospital eligibility.*

```{r ruca-2level}
df2 <- geo_conus |>
  left_join(ruca_zip, by="zip5_key") |>
  mutate(

    ),
    .color = c(`Urban (RUCA 1–6)`="#2171B5", `Rural (RUCA 7–10)`="#D7301F", Unknown="#BDBDBD")[rurality],
    .popup = build_popup(pick(everything()),
                         paste0("<b>CMS Setting:</b> ", rurality,

}
m2 |>
```

`r sprintf("Urban: %.1f%% · Rural: %.1f%%",

Rural share under this definition: approximately **`r sprintf("%.0f", 100*mean(df2$rurality=="Rural (RUCA 7–10)"))`%** of ENT physicians practice in CMS-defined rural areas.

## NCHS 2013 — 6-Level

*NCHS county-level scheme based on OMB February 2013 metro delineations. Distinguished by principal-city location rule for large MSAs (≥1M pop).*

```{r nchs-2013}
df_nchs13 <- geo_county |>
  left_join(nchs |> select(county_fips, CODE2013), by="county_fips") |>
  mutate(
    nchs_label = nchs_labels[as.character(CODE2013)],
    nchs_label = coalesce(nchs_label, "Unknown"),
    nchs_label = factor(nchs_label, levels=c(names(nchs_colors), "Unknown")),

mn13 <- leaflet(options=leafletOptions(preferCanvas=TRUE)) |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)
for (lv in lvls_nchs) {
```

## FAR 2020 — Frontier & Remote

*USDA FAR codes identify extreme remoteness. Levels are **nested** (confirmed from data): FAR 4 ⊆ FAR 3 ⊆ FAR 2 ⊆ FAR 1. Each physician is coded at their most extreme tier.*

| Level | Criteria | ZIPs nationally |
|---|---|---|
| FAR 1 | ≥60 min from 50K+ city (broadest) | 6,090 |
| FAR 2 | + ≥45 min from 25K–50K city | 1,567 additional |
| FAR 3 | + ≥30 min from 10K–25K city | 346 additional |
| FAR 4 | + ≥15 min from 5K–10K city (most extreme) | 3,411 |

*(Level 4 count from data: 3,411 ZIPs meet all four criteria simultaneously.)*

```{r far-2020}
df_far <- geo_conus |>
  left_join(far_zip |> select(zip5_key, far_tier), by="zip5_key") |>
  mutate(
    far_tier = coalesce(far_tier, "Unknown"),
    far_tier = factor(far_tier,
      levels=c("Non-FAR",
               "FAR 1 — Remote (large cities only)",
               "FAR 2 — Remote",
               "FAR 3 — Deep Frontier",
               "FAR 4 — Extreme Frontier",
               "Unknown")),
    .color = c(
      `Non-FAR`                          = "#2171B5",
      `FAR 1 — Remote (large cities only)` = "#FD8D3C",
      `FAR 2 — Remote`                   = "#E31A1C",
      `FAR 3 — Deep Frontier`            = "#BD0026",
      `FAR 4 — Extreme Frontier`         = "#800026",
      Unknown                            = "#BDBDBD"
    )[as.character(far_tier)],
    .popup = build_popup(pick(everything()),
                         paste0("<b>FAR 2020:</b> ", as.character(far_tier), "<br>"))
  )

pal_far <- c(
  `Non-FAR`                          = "#2171B5",
  `FAR 1 — Remote (large cities only)` = "#FD8D3C",
  `FAR 2 — Remote`                   = "#E31A1C",
  `FAR 3 — Deep Frontier`            = "#BD0026",
  `FAR 4 — Extreme Frontier`         = "#800026",
  Unknown                            = "#BDBDBD"
)
lvls_far <- names(pal_far)

mfar <- leaflet(options=leafletOptions(preferCanvas=TRUE)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)
for (lv in lvls_far) {
  sub <- df_far[as.character(df_far$far_tier) == lv, ]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  mfar <- mfar |> addCircleMarkers(data=sub, lng=~longitude, lat=~latitude,
    color=pal_far[[lv]], fillColor=pal_far[[lv]], fillOpacity=0.8, opacity=0.9,
    radius=ifelse(lv=="Non-FAR", 4, 7),
    stroke=lv!="Non-FAR", weight=1.5,
    popup=~.popup, label=~paste(full_name, "—", as.character(far_tier)), group=lv)
}
mfar |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups=lvls_far, options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=FALSE)) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", colors=unname(pal_far[lvls_far]), labels=lvls_far,
            title="<b>USDA FAR 2020</b><br><small>Levels nested: FAR 4 ⊆ FAR 3 ⊆ FAR 2 ⊆ FAR 1</small>")
```

```{r far-summary}
n_far_any <- sum(df_far$far_tier != "Non-FAR" & df_far$far_tier != "Unknown", na.rm=TRUE)
n_far4    <- sum(df_far$far_tier == "FAR 4 — Extreme Frontier", na.rm=TRUE)
n_far1_only <- sum(df_far$far_tier == "FAR 1 — Remote (large cities only)", na.rm=TRUE)
```

<div class="anomaly-box">
**Frontier & Remote finding:** Only **`r n_far_any`** ENT physicians practice in any FAR-designated area.
Of these, **`r n_far4`** are in the most extreme tier (FAR 4: ≥15 min from any town of 5K+, ≥60 min from any city of 50K+) and **`r n_far1_only`** are in the mildest tier (FAR 1 only: simply ≥60 min from a 50K+ city but near smaller towns).
These physicians represent the thinnest thread of ENT access for extreme frontier populations.
</div>

# Technical Notes

**Data sources:**

- **enthealth.org** scraped `r format(as.Date("2026-05-04"), "%B %d, %Y")` via the
  AAO-HNS Find-an-ENT WordPress AJAX endpoint. Specialty labels are self-reported by
  the physician at profile creation and may be updated at any time.
- **NPPES** February 2026 National Downloadable File (NPI Data File).
  Taxonomy codes are self-reported at NPI enumeration. NPPES does not audit or validate
  taxonomy accuracy, and providers are responsible for maintaining their own records.

**NUCC taxonomy codes referenced:**

```{r tax-table}
tax_ref <- data.frame(
  Code  = names(TAX_LABEL),
  Label = unname(TAX_LABEL),
  `Type` = c("Primary (generic)","Subspecialty","Subspecialty","Subspecialty",
              "Subspecialty","Subspecialty","Subspecialty","Subspecialty (alt)","Subspecialty")
)
kable(tax_ref) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
```

**Matching algorithm:** Four-pass deterministic matching (exact last name + state + first
initial → relax initial → strip punctuation → Levenshtein ≤ 1). Ties broken by Jaro-Winkler
similarity on the first name. No probabilistic thresholds — every match is deterministic.

**Phone decoding:** Vanity letters decoded via standard ITU-T E.161 telephone keypad mapping
(A–C→2, D–F→3, G–I→4, J–L→5, M–O→6, P–S→7, T–V→8, W–Z→9).
